project_name: Rockbridge Area Network Authority RAP Data Center
status_detail: RANA, a public broadband authority established by Rockbridge County, Lexington, Buena Vista and Washington & Lee University, operates an open-access fiber network and carrier-neutral colocation/data services at the Richard A.
